caption:
APOEL beat Achilleas Kaimakliou 84-62 in the ECOMMBX Basket League on Friday night. 🏀

The home win at Lefkotheo takes APOEL to two wins and one defeat. Achilleas Kaimakliou are still looking for their first win after three games.

APOEL visit Apollon Limassol next, on Monday 2 November. Who impressed you? 🇨🇾

📸 Kerkida
Source: Cyprus Basketball Federation, Kerkida
@basketcyprus
#SportsWireCY #CyprusBasketball
